In 2025, the spillover effects of geopolitical conflicts and confrontations           2025 年，地 緣 政 治 衝 突 與 博 弈 外 溢 效 應 凸 顯，
became increasingly prominent, leading to heightened volatility in the                國際經貿金融秩序波動加劇，貿易保護主義、
international economic, trade, and financial order. Trade protectionism               單邊關稅措施對全球產業鏈供應鏈穩定與重構
and unilateral tariff measures significantly disrupted the stability and              形成顯著衝擊。在複雜外部環境之下，中國經
restructuring of global industrial and supply chains. Amid this complex               濟展現出強勁韌性，人工智能等新技術加速規
external environment, China’s economy demonstrated robust resilience,                 模化應用，為經濟高質量發展奠定了堅實基礎。
supported by the accelerated large-scale application of new technologies such
as artificial intelligence, which laid a solid foundation for high-quality economic
development.

Against this backdrop, Skyworth Group steadfastly adhered to its development          在此背景之下，創維集團始終堅持以「AI 技術全
strategy of “comprehensively empowering industrial upgrades with AI                   面賦能產業升級，以全球化佈局拓寬發展邊界，
technology, expanding development horizons through global outreach, and               以全品類協同激活增長動能」的發展思路，各業
activating growth momentum via full-category synergy”. Each business                  務板塊在挑戰中攻堅、在創新中突破。本集團
segment has persevered through challenges and achieved breakthroughs                  全年整體營收實現穩步增長，首次突破人民幣
through innovation. The Group’s total annual revenue recorded steady growth,          700 億元大關。藉此，我謹代表創維集團董事會
surpassing the RMB70 billion mark for the first time. On this occasion, on behalf     和執行團隊，向長期以來給予我們信任與支持
of the Board of Directors and the executive team of Skyworth Group, I would           的股東、客戶、合作夥伴以及拚搏奮進的全體
like to extend our sincerest gratitude and highest respect to our shareholders,       員工，致以最誠摯的感謝與崇高的敬意！
customers, and partners for their continued trust and support, as well as to all
our dedicated employees for their unwavering commitment.

Looking back on 2025, each of Skyworth Group’s business segments overcame             回 望 2025 年，創 維 集 團 各 業 務 板 塊 攻 堅 克 難、
challenges and achieved breakthroughs through innovation. The advantages              創新突破。主要核心業務優勢持續鞏固，新興
of our core businesses continued to strengthen, while the growth momentum             業務增長勢能持續釋放。

           longer probable that sufficient taxable profits will be available to                  應課稅溢利以收回全部或部分資產

           temporary differences.                                                                差額確認遞延稅項負債。

      goods sold or services provided, for the purpose of reporting to the chief          定其營運分部，以便向主要經營決策者（即

      Company). Individual operating segments for which discrete financial                資料的個別經營分部由主要經營決策者鑒
      information is available are identified by the CODM and are operated                定並由其各自的管理團隊經營。該等個別
      by their respective management teams. These individual operating                    經營分部合計總額達致本集團可呈報分部。
      segments are aggregated in arriving at the reportable segments of the
      Group.

    (c)   Fair value measurements of financial instruments                           (c)    金融工具公允價值計量
          In estimating the fair value of an asset or a liability, the Group                在 估 計 資 產 或 負 債 的 公 允 價 值 時，
          uses market-observable data to the extent it is available. Where                  本集團於可行情況下盡量使用市場
          Level 1 inputs are not available, the Group engages third party                   可觀察數據。倘無法獲得級別 1 輸入
          qualified valuers to perform the valuation. The accounting team                   數 據，本 集 團 將 委 託 第 三 方 合 資 格
          works closely with the qualified external valuers to establish                    估 值 師 進 行 估 值。會 計 團 隊 與 合 資
          the appropriate valuation techniques and inputs to the model.                     格 外 聘 估 值 師 密 切 合 作，以 確 立 適
          The fluctuations in the fair value of the assets and liabilities are              用於該模型的估值技術及輸入數據。
          explained to the board of directors of the Company.                               資產及負債的公允價值出現之波動
                                                                                            則向本公司董事會解釋。

          Fair values are categorised into different fair value hierarchy                   公允價值根據估值技術所使用的輸
          based on the inputs used in the valuation techniques as follows:                  入數據分為不同公允價值層級如下：

          •     Level 1 fair value measurements are those derived from                      •   第一級公允價值計量乃根據相
                quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical                      同資產或負債在活躍市場中的
                assets or liabilities                                                           報價（未經調整）釐定

          •     Level 2 fair value measurements are those derived from                      •   第二級公允價值計量乃根據資
                inputs other than quoted prices included within Level 1                         產 或 負 債 的 可 觀 察 輸 入 值（不
                that are observable for the asset or liability, either directly                 論 直 接（即 價 格）或 間 接（即 從
                (i.e. as prices) or indirectly (i.e. derived from prices)                       價格推算））釐定，而該等輸入
                                                                                                值並非第一級所採用的報價

          •     Level 3 fair value measurements are those derived from                      •   第三級公允價值計量乃根據估
                valuation techniques for which the lowest level input that is                   值技術釐定，該等技術採用對
                significant to the fair value measurement is unobservable                       公允價值計量而言屬重大的不
                (significant unobservable input)                                                可 觀 察 輸 入 值（重 大 不 可 觀 察
                                                                                                輸入值）

          Information about the valuation techniques and inputs used                        有關釐定不同資產及負債公允價值
          in determining the fair value of various assets and liabilities is                所使用的估值技術及輸入數據的資
          disclosed below.                                                                  料已於下文披露。

          No changes in the business or economic circumstances that                         本 公 司 董 事 認 為，概 無 出 現 對 金 融
